description: Labelled retrieval set. relevant: chunk_id -> graded relevance (2 = directly answers, 1 = useful supporting context). 'negatives' have no relevant passage in the corpus and are used to calibrate the evidence gate. 'hard_negatives' are on-topic but the corpus does not contain the asked fact (reported separately, not used for calibration). Label review: after the first run, q07 (§3.3 item 5 states who approves) and q41 (§3.22 says to report loss of a device promptly) each received a second grade-2 passage because that passage directly answers the question; no other labels were changed.
